description: Stippled living horn: dark source-derived pits, soft pigment growth bands and satin response; pigment-only crest band.

head_side.notes: Black region / alpha holes are the gape and face. Nostril is an opaque region-2 slit with a dark floor and shallow height groove. Fuzz overlap cuts into the horn edge. The band affects regions only; base, relief and roughness continue through it.

height_encoding: 0..65535 is 0..height_mm; neutral plane at half-range. Height contains surface microrelief and shallow keel/rim placement guides, not the skull volume.
normal: OpenGL, computed from quantized delivered height, central differences at span_m/2048.
packed: R occlusion from height, G roughness (linear), B metalness=0.

feature_scale_mm.scratch_location: 19 sparse strokes on beak tip and cutting edge only
